name: deploy-gated
description: A change that ends in a gated action. The approval node PARKS the run and checkpoints, rather than blocking a process while it waits. The Owner decides out of band; resume continues from exactly that point without re-billing completed work.

nodes.name: build
nodes.task: Make the change. Match existing conventions and add tests.

nodes.name: verify
nodes.task: Run the build and full test suite. Quote exit codes verbatim.

nodes.name: release-gate
nodes.criteria: The build and tests pass with quoted exit codes, the change is scoped to what was asked, and nothing touches auth, secrets or infrastructure without explicit review. PASS requires citable evidence.

nodes.name: repair
nodes.task: Fix the root cause of the reported failure, not the symptom.

nodes.name: rethink
nodes.task: The approach failed repeatedly. Pick a materially different one and justify it.

nodes.name: security-review
nodes.task: Review for vulnerabilities and report severity-ranked findings.

nodes.name: owner-approval
nodes.task: This step deploys. Per safety.md, production changes require the Owner's explicit approval. Nothing past this point runs until it is granted.

nodes.name: deploy
nodes.task: Perform the approved release steps and report what changed.
